/**
 * Boutique en ligne.
 * @title boutique-ts
 */
import type { Something } from "./elsewhere"

export type UserStatus = "active" | "invited" | "blocked"

export enum OrderStatus {
  Pending = "pending",
  Paid = "paid",
  Shipped = "shipped",
}

/** Une personne qui achète chez nous. */
export interface User {
  id: string
  /** Prénom et nom, tels que saisis. */
  name: string
  email: string
  phone?: string
  city: string | null
  status: UserStatus
  tags: string[]
  address: Address
  createdAt: Date
  updatedAt: Date
  readonly nickname?: string | undefined
  greet(): string
}

export interface Address {
  street: string
  zip: string
  city: string
  country?: "FR" | "BE" | "CH"
}

export interface Order {
  id: number
  customer: User
  items: Array<OrderLine>
  status: OrderStatus
  total: number
  notes: Record<string, string>
  meta?: { source: string; campaign?: string }
}

export interface OrderLine {
  productName: string
  unitPrice: number
  quantity: number
}

export type CreateUser = Omit<User, "id" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt" | "address"> & { address?: Partial<Address> }
export type UpdateUser = Partial<Pick<User, "name" | "phone" | "status">>

const helper = (x: number) => x * 2
